description: Let AI coding agents use your secrets without ever seeing them. Encrypted local vault, self-hosted Vaultwarden/Bitwarden, or your team's HashiCorp Vault, OpenBao, Infisical, 1Password, AWS, Google Cloud or Azure secrets; masked output, MCP server, Claude
